title: K Most Frequent Words
statement:
Given a list of words and an integer K, return the K most frequent words.

If two words have the same frequency, sort them alphabetically.

Print the words one per line, ordered by frequency descending (then alphabetically for ties).
constraints:
1 <= K <= number of distinct words
1 <= total words <= 10^4
1 <= |word| <= 20
All words are lowercase English letters only.
inputFormat:
The first line contains N and K.
The second line contains N space-separated words.
outputFormat: K lines, one word per line.

examples.input:
8 2
the day is cool the weather is hot
examples.explanation: 'is' appears 2 times, 'the' appears 2 times; tie broken alphabetically: 'is' < 'the'.

examples.input:
6 2
i love leetcode i love coding

n, k = map(int, input().split())
